evidence_quote: an investigation later showed the reports to be false
rationale: The evidence explicitly states that "an investigation later showed the reports to be false" regarding the claim that the Sun had been confirmed to harbor a previously undetected magnetic anomaly. Since the evidence establishes that the reports of this confirmation were false, it directly contradicts the claim that the Sun *was* confirmed to harbor such an anomaly.
review_note: Correctly targets false reports of confirmation, not anomaly existence.
reviewer: Codex Agent: direct per-item evidence and full draft review
